title: Seljuk Dynasty
capsule: Before founding an empire, the Seljuks were an Oghuz Turkic clan led by the grandsons of the eponymous chieftain Seljuk, Tughril Beg and Chaghri Beg, who entered Ghaznavid-ruled Khorasan as mercenaries-turned-rebels and seized Merv and Nishapur between 1028 and 1038. Their decisive victory over the Ghaznavid sultan Mas'ud I at the Battle of Dandanaqan on 23 May 1040 broke Ghaznavid power in the region and transformed the clan from a tribal following into the founders of an imperial dynasty.
